Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The umpires and the players are back in the middle. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma are all-set to open the innings for India Women. It will be Diana Baig who will get proceedings underway with the ball for Pakistan Women.
... The Run Chase ...

India were on the money right from the word go. Meghna Singh drew the first blood in her very first over and set a platform for the rest of the bowlers. It was only the second-wicket stand that bothered India, other than that they were on the driving seat throughout. The spinners specially did really well to dry up the run flow. Sneh Rana and Radha Yadav picked two each. Only Deepti Sharma failed to get into the wicket's column. India Women would certainly back themselves to chase this target down but it won't be an easy one. Do join us for the chase on the other side.

Once again in this competition Pakistan were unable to start well with the blade. They started their innings with 8 dot balls followed up with a wicket and were on the back foot straightaway. However, Maroof and Ali batted brilliantly and managed to stable the ship with their 50-run stand which lacked boundaries though. These two could not continue for long as they both departed in a single over. Since then, none of the batters got going and they lost wickets in a flurry. Their bowlers don't have much to defend but would not make it easy for India to get over the line.

A top class performance by India Women sees them walk out as the happier side. They have outclassed their opposition here. For Pakistan, no one could turn up with the blade and they have been bowled out in 18 overs.

OUT! TIMBER! Radha Yadav finishes things off in style! This is nicely flighted, full and around middle and leg. Kainat Imtiaz tries to make a bit of room and slog it away but gets beaten in flight. The ball turns away and clatters into the off stump. A poor end to the innings by Pakistan Women and they have been bundled out on the final delivery for 99 runs!
Anam Amin is the last batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Pakistan Women have time and again challenged the Indian fielders and they have come out second best. Tossed up, full and on middle. Kainat Imtiaz uses her feet and pushes it down to long on. The batters look for two right away but will have to hurry. The substitute fielder, Harleen Deol picks up the ball cleanly and fires in a flat throw towards the bowler. Tuba Hassan puts in the desperate dive but the bails are whipped off before she can make her ground.
Commentary.Howout: run out (sub Harleen Deol / Radha Yadav)

Commentary.Commentary: Drags it down, outside off and this is played well in front of square on the off side for a single.
A touch fuller, on off and turning away sharply. Hassan has a dab at it but misses.
Tuba Hassan comes in to bat now.

OUT! STUMPED! Another one bites the dust! Lovely piece of bowling from Radha Yadav, flighted, on a length and around middle. The ball is allowed to grip and turns away a long way. Baig looks to step out but is completely beaten in flight. Yastika Bhatia whips off the bails and third umpire or not, that is clearly out. The finger is raised by the square leg umpire and Pakistan Women lose their eighth.
Commentary.Howout: st Yastika Bhatia b Radha Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: Just short! Nice bit of flight from Radha Yadav, this is bowled on leg stump. Kainat Imtiaz looks to sweep but gets a top edge that loops up well in front of short fine leg. Renuka Singh dives in front but can't reach it. Single taken.

Diana Baig is the new batter in. There is some delay now due to a technical issue with the third umpire. Hopefully, t doesn't take long before the final over of this innings gets started. Now, Harmanpreet Kaur is seen having a chat with the umpire. She informs that the no balls will be called by the on-field umpires now, due to the technical difficuties.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Shafali Verma with the golden arm and Pakistan Women keep on losing wickets in heaps. This is tossed up on middle, Fatima Sana dances down the track and hits it firmly but uppishly to the right of the bhowler. Verma dives to her right and grabs it with both hands. The catch is a low one and even Verma isn't quite sure. The umpires go upstairs and thye soft signal is out. The third umpire checks it from a few angles and the fingers seem to be underneath the ball. The decision is OUT and Sana cannot believe it.

Is this a clean catch? The two umpires converge and decide to take it upstairs to check a clean catch. The soft signal is OUT. The replays confirm that Shafali Verma does get her fingers under the ball. As there is no conclusive decision to overturn the decision. The big screen shows OUT.
Kainat Imtiaz is the new batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Bullet of a throw from Meghna Singh and Aliya Riaz has to walk back! Tossed up, full and on off. Aliya Riaz steps out and hits it firmly past the bowler and towards mid off. Riaz sets off for the single right away. Singh though picks it up quickly and fires it in at the bowler's end. The ball hits the base of the stumps and the replays show that Riaz is short of her crease.
Is that a run out? The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The replays show that Aliya Riaz is short of the crease and has to walk back. The big screen shows OUT and the stadium errupts once again.
Around off, this is dabbed down towards point for one.

Excellent work in the deep from Jemimah Rodrigues. This is floated up outside off, Sana uses her feet to generate a bit of pace and drives it through extra cover. Rodrigues races to her right from the cover fence and puts in the dive to keep the play in play. Two taken.
Really slow through the air, shorter and outside off. Fatima Sana looks to cut off the back foot but misses.
The physio is out! Aliya Riaz is hit hard on her arm by the throw. The physio gets the magic spray out. Hopefully, it won;t be long before Riaz is good to go.

Ouch! That must have stung! Floated up, around middle, Aliya Riaz looks to slog it away but gets an inside edge down to short fine leg. The batters scamper through for one and the throw is fired in at the non-striker's end. The ball hits Riaz on the back and we hope that she is fine.
FOUR! Cut away! This is quicker and flatter, around off, this is played off the back foot by Fatima Sana and through point for a boundary.
On a length and on off, Riaz looks to use her feet and go big but has to check her shot and work it towards square leg for one.
Swing and a miss! Flighted, full and outside off, Riaz swings wildly across the line but makes no connection.
FOUR! Good shot! Slightly tossed up, around middle. Aliya Riaz comes down the track and lifts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Full again and on off, pushed away towards extra cover.
This is full and around off, Sana looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto her boot. The ball rolls away onto the off side and a quick single is taken.
Shorter, outside off. Riaz cuts it to deep point for a brace.
Fatima Sana is the new batter in.

OUT! RUN OUT! A huge mix-up in the middle and Omaima Sohail is left high and dry by her partner. This is considerably slowed up by Shafali Verma and outside off. Aliya Riaz waits for it and should be putting it away but hitys it to the right of cover-point. Radha Yadav over there makes a good stop with both hands and sees that Sohail is halfway down the track. There is no response from Riaz as the ball is thrown back to the bowler and Verma teases a little before dislodging the bails.
This is around middle and leg, Sohail lofts it towards long on for one more.
Just a bit of flight, around off. Aliya Riaz shuffles across and heaves it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Outside off again and this is played towards extra cover.
Starts off with a shortish delivery, wide of the off pole. Riaz cuts it straight towards cover-point.
Shafali Verma to roll her arm now.
Flatter, outside off. Riaz cuts it to deep point for one.

EDGY! It is floated and full, on off. Omaima Sohail comes down the track and swings hard at it. The ball takes the outside edge and goes down to third man. The batters take three. Yastika Bhatia misses out this time.
Full, on off. Riaz works it to deep mid-wicket for one.

NOT OUT! This is very close but Aliya Riaz remains out at the crease with her back leg grounded throughout. It is tossed up, around off, this grips and turns away sharply. Aliya Riaz tries for the sweep but misses. Yastika Bhatia collects and is quick to take the bails off, although the batter had her foot grounded.

Is that stumped? There is a solid appeal from the keeper Yastika Bhatia for stumping and we are going upstairs once again. The catch will be checked first but UltraEdge shows no spike so, we will now move on to the stumping. The replay shows that Riaz had her back leg back inside and it will be NOT OUT.

Full and on off. Riaz dabs it to point. She ventures out looking for a single but is sent back. The fielder scores a direct hit at the striker's end but there is no excitement in the field. The third umpire though gives it a look and confirms that the batter is safe.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Omaima Sohail sweeps it to fine leg for one.
Radha Yadav is back on.

A loud appeal for lbw but turned down! The keeper and the bowler look convinced though and Harmanpreet Kaur takes the review. Coming to the delivery, It is tossed up, full, turning in a bit from outside off. Aliya Riaz comes down the track, misses her flick and gets rapped on her pads. The UltraEdge show no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows that it is umpire's call on impact and hence the on-field decision stands. India Women though do not lose the review.
Tossed up, full, wide outside off. Riaz tries to drive it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Flighted and full, on off stump. Riaz goes back and blocks it back to the bowler.
Fuller, on off. Riaz pushes it to cover.
Floated and full, around off. Riaz looks to drive it away but gets an outside edge to third man. The batters take two before the fielder cuts it out.
FOUR! Nicely played! Aliya Riaz gets her first boundary of the innings. It is tossed up, down leg. Riaz gets low and drags her sweep to fine leg for a boundary.
Length this time, on the pads, Riaz nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single.

Another risky single but they make it through. Very full again, a low full toss and on middle. Sohail pushes it towards mid on and sets off for a run but there's a bit of hesitation. Thankfully for Pakistan Women, the fielder fumbles and they get the run in the end.
This is very full and around off, Sohail jams it out towards mid off.
Aliya Riaz is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Renuka Singh gets herself into the wicket's column. It is a full-length ball, on off. Ayesha Naseem gets low and tries to slog it away. The ball goes high in the air towards mid-wicket. Jemimah Rodrigues charges in from the deep and pouches it safely. India in the driving seat now.
Commentary.Howout: c Jemimah Rodrigues b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, around middle and leg. Sohail works it to square leg for one.

Dangerous running but no harm done! It is full, on off. Naseem drives it to mid off and calls for a single, although she hits it straight to the fielder. There is never a run here. Ayesha Naseem could've been in trouble but the fielder misses her attempt at the non-striker's end.
Renuka Singh (3-1-16-0) is back on to complete her spell.
Looped up, on off, defends it to cover.

Brilliant delivery yet again! It flighted and full, just outside off. Sohail tries to drive it away but misses it completely. Yastika Bhatia also fails to grab the ball cleanly. Might've misses a stumping opportunity this time.
Fuller, outside off. Sohail tries to sweep it away but misses.
Quicker and full, wide outside off. Naseem shuffles across and cross bats it to long on for one.
On off, defended to covers.
Floated and full, outside off. Sohail drives it aerially through covers. It lands safely and they take one.
Flatter and around off, this is slapped away towards cover-point where Smriti Mandhana gets a hand on it. The batters get back for two.
Tossed up a bit, full and around off, Naseem looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
FOUR! And again! Shorter and on leg stump, Ayesha Naseem goes on the back foot and powers it flat towards the wide long on fence for a boundary.
Just a tad shorter and this is muscles away off the back foot towards wide long on for a couple of runs.

Just short! Lovely bit of flight from Radha Yadav this time, around middle and leg. The ball grips and turns and takes the leading edge of Ayesha Naseem's willow. The ball loops up and falls short of the diving fielder at short cover.
Starts off with a flatter delivery, around leg. Omaima Sohail goes on the back foot and tucks it away leg side for a single.
Ayesha Naseem comes in at number 5.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Soft, soft dismissal in the end for Muneeba Ali and Sneh Rana has turned the game on its head. Rana angles it into leg stump, Ali is once again caught in between using her feet or staying put and in the end, she does neither. Ali just pushes the ball gently back to the bowler who takes a simple return catch. Pakistan Women lose both the set batters and have to re-build once again.
Around off, this is nicely driven through covers for a single by Sohail.
Floated and full, outside off. Sohail tries to push it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Omaima Sohail is the new batter in.

OUT! LBW! Sneh Rana gets the breakthrough for India Women and the Pakistan Women skipper has to depart. This is floated up on a length and on off stump, Bismah Maroof shuffles across to sweep it fine but misses and gets pinged on the pads. A huge appeal for lbw and it is given! Bismah Maroof has a chat with her partner and decides to go upstairs. It looked pretty straight but maybe the angle of the delivery is what tempted the review. There is no spike on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows up three reds as the ball is hitting the middle of middle.
Rana fires this one in full and around off, Maroof digs it out towards extra cover.
Full, on leg stump and Ali just eases it well in front of mid-wicket for a single. The 50 is up for Pakistan Women.
Around off, edged down towards short third man. Ali wants the single but Maroof sends her back.
Singh switches to over the wicket and angles it across the left-hander. Ali looks to drive but gets a thick outside edge down to third man for a run.
SIX! BANG! Finally, Muneeba Ali connects and it has gone all the way. This is in the slot around off and angled in, Ali heaves it hard and flat over the cow corner fence for a biggie.

Great effort from Sneh Rana but she just can't reach it. This is a length ball around off, Ali lofts it high and towards extra cover. Rana runs towards the ball from mid off and puts in the dive but can't grab it. Two taken.

FOUR! Lucky boundary for Muneeba Ali and she continues to extend her stay at the crease. This is a good short ball, around shoulder height and around off. Ali gets hurried on and gets a top edge that flies down into the fine leg fence.
Singh comes back into the attack and comes from around the wicket. This is angled in on a length and from outside off, Maroof drives it behind point and picks up a single.
Very full and on off, Maroof squeezes it out on the off side for a run.
Angled into off, Maroof steps out and punches it to the left of the bowler who makes a good diving stop.

In the air but safe! On middle and leg, Ali steps out and tries to force it down the ground. Ali ends up lofting it right back over the bowler's head and the fielder from mid off can't reach it. Single taken.
Excellent running! Quicker and flatter, close to the off stump, Maroof cuts it off the outside edge towards short third man and scampers through for one.

Very lucky! This is flighted full and well outside off, Muneeba Ali tries to use her feet but gets yorked. Ali gets an inside edge and the ball goes agonizingly over the stumps towards short fine leg. They get a single.
Sneh Rana starts her spell off with a flatter delivery around off. Maroof taps it towards covers for one.
Muneeba Ali trying to up the ante here but it isn't quite coming off. Ali shuffles well across the off stump as Deepti Sharma follows here. Ali tries to slog it away but gets hit on the pads.
A tad short and wide, Bismah Maroof rocks back and eases it through cover-point for yet another single.
Flatter and outside off, played off the back foot through covers for one more.
Swing and a miss! This is floated up full and around off, Muneeba Ali looks for the big slog-sweep against the turn but is well beaten.
On the pads, Maroof tucks it away towards square leg for an easy single.

Excellent bowling! Deepti Sharma sees Muneeba Ali advancing and just floats it up on a shorter length and on leg stump. Ali has to make an adjustment and fends it away on the off side for a quick single.

NOT OUT! Bismah Maroof makes it safely to the other end. Coming to the delivery. It is a length ball, on leg stump. Ali shuffles way across to the off side and flicks it to fine leg. The fielders collects the ball and throws it quickly to the keeper who takes the bails off. The umpire takes it upstairs to check the run out and the replays show that Maroof is safely inside the popping line. They get a single in the end.
Is that a Run-Out? There is half an appeal from the Indian players for a run-out at the keeper's end. The umpires go upstairs but the replays show that Bismah Maroof is well in. NOT OUT!
A dot now! Renuka Singh comes from 'round the wicket and dishes it full, around off. Ali clips it to the leg side.
Another single now. It is full, on the pads, Maroof nudges it to square leg for one. 10 runs off the over already. Can Pakistan find one more boundary in this over?
A single now as this is tucked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This should release some pressure. It is fuller in length, on middle and leg. Ali stays back and flicks it through mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.
FOUR! Muneeba Ali gets her first boundary. It is a full-length delivery, around off. Ali moves to the leg side, makes some room and smashes it over covers for a boundary.
Nicely played! Darted in on the pads, Maroof sweeps it behind square on the leg side and races back for two.
Tossed up on the pads, Maroof looks to get down low and sweep but opts out of the shot and just blocks it out.
Fuller, on off. Maroof comes down the track and blocks it out.
A single now as this is hit towards long on.
On off, blocked out.

NOT OUT! Muneeba Ali is safely inside the crease, nonetheless an excellent bit of fielding by Renuka Singh. It is tossed up, full and on off. Ali sweeps it to square leg. Renuka Singh dives to her right to make a solid stop. Bismah Maroof initially calls for a single but the sharp fielding forces her to send back Ali. Renuka throws it to the keeper, who clips the bails quickly but the batter is safely in. The third umpire confirms it.
Is that a run-out? Renuka Singh picks up the ball around mid-wicket and throws it towards the keeper who whips off the bails. The decision is sent upstairs and Muneeba Ali is back in.
With two left-handers at the crease, the off-spinner, Deepti Sharma has been brought on.
These two are making sure to keep the runs ticking. It is full length, on middle and leg. Maroof clips it through the gap at mid-wicket. The call is for two and the get two.
Maroof drives this full length delivery gently towards mid off.
Full length, on off. Ali works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller length, on the pads, Maroof gets it to the right of the keeper with a flick. They collect an easy single.

Full length, on off. Muneeba Ali drives it towards mid on and scampers through for a quick single. Harmanpreet Kaur collects and has a shy at the non-striker's end. Muneeba Ali thinks she could be in trouble and puts in a desperate dive to get inside the crease, although she clashes with Renuka Singh in the process. No one hurt though.
Play and a miss! Full length, wide outside off. Ali tries to chase it but misses.
Full length, on the pads, Ali tucks it to square leg and gets off the mark with a single. A wicket-taking over by Meghna Singh comes to an end.

Nice running! It is fuller, outside off, shaping away from the left-hander. Bismah Maroof leans in and creams it through the cover region. Three fielders give it a chase and eventually save a single for their side.
WIDE! It is full, going down leg. Maroof looks to flick but misses. Wide called.
Bismah Maroof and Pakistan Women are off the mark finally! It is full, on the pads, Maroof flicks it through mid-wicket and collects a brace.
The skipper, Bismah Maroof is in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The opening pair fails again for Pakistan in the tournament. Meghna Singh comes back into the side and draws the first blood. This time Meghna Singh serves a full-length ball, that lands on off and nips away off the deck. Iram Javed tries to block it out but only manages to get a thick outside edge. Yastika Bhatia makes no mistake behind the sticks.
Commentary.Howout: c Yastika Bhatia b Meghna Singh

Commentary.Commentary: It is a length ball, outside off, nips away off the deck. Iram Javed has no shot to offer.
Incredible start by the pacer. Meghna Singh goes full and wide outside off, getting it to shape away as well. Javed lets it through.
Meghna Singh to steam in from the opposite end.
A maiden to start with! Pressure on Pakistan straightaway. Full length, around off. Ali gets it to short third off the outside edge.

Five dots on the trot! On a length, outside off, shaping away. Ali dances down the track and looks to heave it away. She connects only with thin air. No danger of stumping as well as the keeper did back out before this delivery.
A length ball, on off. Ali defends it out watchfully. The keeper is up to the stumps with Ali using her feet.
Singh serves a length ball, on leg stump this time. Ali comes down the track, tries to flick it away but misses to wear it on the pads.
BEATEN AGAIN! Renuka Singh on the money yet again. It is much fuller this time, angled across. Ali tries to block it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Renuka Singh starts her spell with a full-length delivery, angled across the left-hander. Muneeba Ali tries to defend it out but does so inside the line.

Finally, after a lot of small delays due to the rain, we are ready for the start of play! The news from the middle is that actually, we have lost some overs. The match is now reduced to 18 overs per side with the Powerplay reduced to the first 5 overs. Three bowlers can bowl their complete quota of 4 overs. The umpires make their way out to the middle and are followed by the players as the crowd gives them a roaring applause. The Indian players are seen in a huddle as the Pakistani openers, Muneeba Ali and Iram Javed stride out to bat. Renuka Singh has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...

Well, the weather has been playing hide and seek for the last few minutes with there being a drizzle once again. But thankfully, the sun is out once again, the covers are off and we haven't lost any overs yet. The actual pitch though is still covered till the players come out to play.

Harmanpreet Kaur, captain of India Women says that they have a couple of changes which are due to the conditions. Mentions that they wanted to bowl first because it is better to chase if DL comes into place. Adds that they want to play like they did against Australia Women and even though they didn't win, they played some outstanding cricket.

Pakistan Women skipper, Bismah Maroof says they will bat first. Starts by saying it in an important match and they aim to put up a strong target on the board. Mentions Nida Dar misses out due to a concussion and Kainat Imtiaz will replace here. Says they are in a tough spot and a win here would be crucial.

Pakistan Women (Playing XI) - Muneeba Ali (WK), Iram Javed, Omaima Sohail, Bismah Maroof (C), Ayesha Naseem, Aliya Riaz, Kainat Imtiaz (In for Nida Dar), Fatima Sana, Tuba Hassan, Diana Baig and Anam Amin.

India Women (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Sabbhineni Meghana (In for Harleen Deol), Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Jemimah Rodrigues, Yastika Bhatia (WK), Deepti Sharma, Radha Yadav, Sneh Rana (In for Rajeshwari Gayakwad), Meghna Singh and Renuka Singh.
TOSS - Pakistan Women have won the toss and they will have a BAT first.

While we wait for the toss, let's have a look at some accomplishments from the Indian contingent in the Commonwealth Games 2022. Just minutes ago, Jeremy Lalrinnunga won the Gold medal in the Weightlifting Men's 67kg. This has now taken India's medal tally to 5 and more importantly it is the 2nd Gold medal. India are now behind Scotland in sixth spot. In his second attempt, Jeremy lifted 160 kg in Clean and Jerk. He has lifted 300kg in the event which is now a CWG record. Apart from Jeremy, Srihari Nataraj is through to the semi-finals in men's 50m backstroke.
